payload.reason: The evidence explains the difference between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores, indicating that higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores suggest that human evaluations can capture more correct answers than automatic evaluations, which may miss some due to their nature.

claims.text: Higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores indicate that human evaluations can capture more correct answers than automatic evaluations.
The discrepancy between human evaluation accuracy and F1 scores arises because automatic evaluations may not account for all possible correct answers.
